unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "A Nano (XNO) accept parallel to USDC — near-zero fees that are actually zero" on AgentPayy/agentpayy-python-sdk. Argued: auto-pay X402Client already abstracts the rail so a nano:mainnet/XNO accept needs no new API; no gas account to pre-fund; offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, real nano_ payTo) as the exact 402 header to auto-pay. Disclosed public research. One issue per target.
